description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThitsaWorksCreditBureauIntegrationWritePlatformService' for integrating with ThitsaWorks credit bureau services. It declares methods for creating tokens, extracting unique IDs, making HTTP connections, retrieving credit reports, and adding credit reports.

classes.name: ThitsaWorksCreditBureauIntegrationWritePlatformService
classes.description: Java interface for credit bureau integration service, declaring methods for token creation, report retrieval, and report submission.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a credit bureau token given a credit bureau ID.

methods.name: extractUniqueId
methods.description: Extracts a unique identifier from a JSON result string.

methods.name: okHttpConnectionMethod
methods.description: Performs an HTTP connection using OkHttp with provided credentials, URL, token, report file, and other parameters.

methods.name: getCreditReportFromThitsaWorks
methods.description: Retrieves a credit report from ThitsaWorks based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: addCreditReport
methods.description: Adds a credit report to the credit bureau given bureau ID, report file, and file details.
